bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28000.1199 Released - This build introduces general improvements for Insiders in the Canary Channel.
Ignite 2025 Highlights AI Integration - Windows evolves to empower organizations with AI tools for enhanced productivity and security.
Windows Security Innovations Unveiled - New features enhance security and resiliency for organizations in the AI era.
Developer Tools Enhanced at Ignite - New tools and frameworks empower developers to create secure AI applications on Windows.
Edge for Business Launched - A secure enterprise AI browser designed to enhance productivity without compromising security.
AI Lifecycle Showcased at Ignite - Microsoft emphasizes the integration of AI throughout organizational workflows for innovation.
Strategic Partnerships Announced - Microsoft collaborates with **NVIDIA** and **Anthropic** to enhance AI capabilities on Azure.
Security Copilot Integrated with Microsoft 365 E5 - New agents enhance security operations, empowering teams to combat cyber threats.
Ambient Security for AI Era Introduced - New solutions aim to secure AI agents and applications across organizational layers.
Copilot Actions Rollout Begins - New feature allows Windows Insiders to perform tasks using AI in a controlled environment.
